lines: You built a heaven out of our graves.
I climbed every damn one.
Keep your crown. I came for the head that wore it.
subject: a black-armored crown-helmet knight with torn crimson cape standing above a shattered golden throne in a ruined white-gold celestial cathedral

lines: That was no throne. It was a lock.
Something below the light is still pulling my chains.
Then I keep climbing. Until there is nothing left to kneel to.
subject: the knight discovering a titanic chain running from a broken heaven through a violet fissure into a hidden cathedral beyond the stars

lines: UNMAKER: I wrote your suffering into the stone.
WARDEN: Then watch me tear out the fucking page.
UNMAKER: You cannot kill the hand that made you.
subject: the knight confronting the Unmaker across a shattered obsidian causeway suspended in a violet cosmic cathedral

lines: You forged me to bear your chains.
You should have made them stronger.
No more masters. No more graves. We walk out of here alive.
subject: the knight breaking his last chains at a ruined cathedral gate as warm dawn reveals a free valley beyond

lines: The choir promised I would die without a name.
Listen carefully. That silence is mine.
Tell your saints Vesper sent them.
subject: an ivory-hooded female assassin with antique gold and black leather armor and twin curved knives looking over a silent white-gold celestial choir filled with broken marble saints

lines: The choir is dead. So who is still singing?
There. A voice behind the wound in the world.
One last throat. One last prayer.
subject: the assassin kneeling beside a thin emerald seam of light in a ruined celestial sanctuary as an immense violet cathedral is revealed beyond it

lines: UNMAKER: Every blade you carried was part of my design.
VESPER: Then you know exactly how this ends.
UNMAKER: I gave you your name. VESPER: You can choke on it.
subject: the assassin facing the Unmaker on an ivory bridge in a violet cosmic cathedral, her twin knives lowered and steady

lines: You taught the world to fear the dark.
Now it knows what the dark was hiding from.
My name is Vesper. And no one owns it anymore.
subject: the assassin casting a cracked ivory ceremonial mask into a dying violet rift, turning toward a golden dawn outside an open cathedral

lines: You crowned yourself with stolen stars.
I have come to collect.
Let heaven remember who brought the fucking sky down.
subject: a blue-robed bronze-crowned star sovereign with a gigantic golden greatsword standing before a fallen celestial throne beneath broken constellations

lines: These stars are not fading. They are being recalled.
A hand beyond the throne still claims them.
It will learn the difference between a sovereign and a servant.
subject: the star sovereign raising a hand as gold constellations reveal hidden chains stretching into a violet cathedral beyond heaven

lines: UNMAKER: I am the law that holds your heavens together.
PROXY: Then let the heavens break.
UNMAKER: Without me, you are nothing. PROXY: Watch nothing rise.
subject: the star sovereign confronting the Unmaker at the center of a shattered cosmic observatory with greatsword planted before him

lines: Your throne was a cage with better lighting.
I owe this world more than another king.
Take back your stars. The sky belongs to all of us.
subject: the star sovereign laying a broken crown on a stone altar as thousands of liberated gold stars rise over a dawn-lit kingdom
